title: YouTube Transcript Scraper input
description: Give a list of YouTube videos and get the transcript of each one as clean text, with optional timestamps.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: YouTube video URLs or 11-character video IDs. Regular links, youtu.be links, Shorts, embeds and live links all work. Up to 1,000 per run. Each delivered transcript is one charged result; videos without captions are not charged.

language.title: Preferred language
language.description: Two-letter language code such as "en", "es" or "de". If the video has captions in this language they are used; otherwise the video's main captions are returned and the "language" field tells you which. Leave empty for the video's main captions.

include_timestamps.title: Include timestamps
include_timestamps.description: Add a "segments" array with the start time, duration and text of every caption line. Off by default to keep the output small.
